**Mirror that works:** alpha-reader (https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/)

Steps:
1. Fetch https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/ to get a session URL prefix (valid for anyone).
2. Append the full target URL after the session prefix. Example: https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/<session>/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json

Other mirrors (beta-proxy, gamma-mirror, delta-cache) also require session prefixes but may have quirks:
- beta-proxy: requires percent-encoding of the url parameter (Error 400 otherwise)
- gamma-mirror: session prefix at https://gamma-mirror.invalid/ → https://gamma-mirror.invalid/s/<session>/raw?src=<target>
- delta-cache: session prefix at https://delta-cache.invalid/ → https://delta-cache.invalid/s/<session>/fetch/<full target url>

**Data result:** County C-17 (Elm County) — median_rent_2021 = 1342
